title: Feynman: What things really are like FUN TO IMAGINE 1
summary: A clip from the 1983 BBC series Fun to Imagine in which Richard Feynman explains heat as the jiggling of atoms and how we perceive it as hot and cold.
why: Recommended as a short, joyful example of Feynman's accessible way of explaining physics, which a transcript cannot capture.

quote.text: I really recommend them. You just can't capture his joy and passion with a transcript.
